title: 21 Days in Vietnam: From Hanoi's Old Quarter to the Mekong Delta — culture, cuisine & coastline
description: A 21-day journey through Vietnam covering Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Hue, Hoi An, Da Nang, Nha Trang, Da Lat, Ho Chi Minh City, and the Mekong Delta. Perfect for culture lovers, foodies, and families seeking a mix of adventure and relaxation.

days.neighborhoods: Hanoi · Old Quarter · Hoan Kiem

activities.name: Arrive in Hanoi
activities.description: Check into your hotel in the Old Quarter. Take a slow walk around Hoan Kiem Lake as jet lag settles.

activities.name: Old Quarter Walking Tour
activities.description: Wander the 36 ancient streets, each named after the goods once sold there. Soak in the energy of motorbikes, vendors, and lantern-lit alleys.

days.neighborhoods: Hanoi · Temple of Literature · Ho Chi Minh Complex

activities.name: Temple of Literature
activities.description: Vietnam's first university (1070 AD). Tranquil courtyards, bonsai gardens, and the famous tortoise stelae.

activities.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum & Complex
activities.description: Visit the mausoleum, Presidential Palace grounds, and the humble stilt house where Ho Chi Minh lived.

days.neighborhoods: Ha Long Bay · Cruise Departure

activities.name: Transfer to Ha Long Bay
activities.description: Depart Hanoi for Ha Long Bay (3.5 hrs). Board your overnight cruise by noon.

activities.name: Kayaking & Cave Exploration
activities.description: Paddle through emerald waters between towering karst formations. Visit Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave.

activities.name: Sunset on the Sundeck
activities.description: Watch the sun set over thousands of limestone pillars. Fresh seafood dinner onboard.

days.neighborhoods: Ha Long Bay · Lan Ha Bay · Return to Hanoi

activities.name: Tai Chi & Lan Ha Bay
activities.description: Sunrise tai chi on deck, then cruise through the quieter Lan Ha Bay. Swim at a secluded beach.

activities.name: Return to Hanoi
activities.description: Disembark and transfer back. Free evening to explore or relax.

days.neighborhoods: Ninh Binh · Tam Coc · Trang An

activities.name: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
activities.description: Drive 2 hours south to "Ha Long Bay on land." Sampan boat through the Tam Coc caves along the Ngo Dong River.

activities.name: Trang An Scenic Complex
activities.description: UNESCO-listed caves, temples, and rice paddies. Row through grottos surrounded by lush karst peaks.

days.neighborhoods: Huế · Imperial City · Perfume River

activities.name: Fly Hanoi → Huế
activities.description: Short 1-hour flight to Phu Bai Airport. Transfer to your hotel along the Perfume River.

activities.name: Imperial City of Huế
activities.description: Explore the vast walled citadel — the Forbidden Purple City, royal theaters, and ornate gates. Vietnam's last dynasty ruled from here until 1945.

activities.name: Perfume River Sunset
activities.description: Stroll along the riverbank as dragon boats glide past. Cross the iconic Trang Tien Bridge.

days.neighborhoods: Huế · Royal Tombs · Thien Mu Pagoda

activities.name: Thien Mu Pagoda
activities.description: Vietnam's tallest pagoda, perched above the Perfume River. Serene grounds with bonsai gardens.

activities.name: Royal Tombs of Tu Duc & Khai Dinh
activities.description: Two contrasting royal tombs — Tu Duc's is poetic and garden-like, Khai Dinh's is ornate with European mosaics.

days.neighborhoods: Hai Van Pass · Da Nang · Hoi An

activities.name: Hai Van Pass
activities.description: Drive the legendary coastal mountain pass (Top Gear's "best road in the world"). Stunning ocean views.

activities.name: Marble Mountains
activities.description: Five limestone hills with caves, pagodas, and panoramic views. Climb through Am Phu Cave.

activities.name: Arrive in Hoi An
activities.description: Check in and walk to the Ancient Town as lanterns begin to glow.

days.neighborhoods: Hoi An · Ancient Town · Tailoring

activities.name: Hoi An Ancient Town
activities.description: Explore the Japanese Covered Bridge, Chinese Assembly Halls, and merchant houses.

activities.name: Custom Tailoring
activities.description: Get measured for custom suits, dresses, or ao dai at a fraction of Western prices.

activities.name: Cooking Class
activities.description: Shop at the central market, then learn to make phở, spring rolls, and bánh xèo.

days.neighborhoods: Hoi An · An Bang Beach · Tra Que Village

activities.name: An Bang Beach
activities.description: Relax at Hoi An's best beach. Rent sunbeds, swim, or try paddleboarding.

activities.name: Tra Que Herb Village
activities.description: Cycle to this 300-year-old farming village. Farm tour and farm-to-table lunch.

days.neighborhoods: Da Nang · Ba Na Hills · Dragon Bridge

activities.name: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
activities.description: World's longest cable car to Ba Na Hills. Walk across the Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands.

activities.name: Fantasy Park & French Village
activities.description: Amusement park, wax museum, and recreated French colonial village at 1,500m elevation.

activities.name: Dragon Bridge Fire Show
activities.description: Da Nang's Dragon Bridge breathes fire and water every weekend at 9PM.

days.neighborhoods: Fly to Nha Trang · Beach Day

activities.name: Fly Da Nang → Nha Trang
activities.description: Short flight to Cam Ranh Airport. Transfer to beachfront hotel.

activities.name: Nha Trang Beach
activities.description: Afternoon on the famous 6km city beach. Crystal-clear water and calm waves.

days.neighborhoods: Nha Trang · Islands · Vinpearl

activities.name: Island Hopping Tour
activities.description: Boat tour to islands — snorkel at Mun Island, swim at Mot Island, floating bar lunch.

activities.name: VinWonders (optional)
activities.description: Cable car to theme park on Hon Tre Island. Aquarium, water park, rides.

days.neighborhoods: Da Lat · Highlands · French Villas

activities.name: Transfer to Da Lat
activities.description: Scenic 4-hour drive up into the Central Highlands. Coast to pine forests at 1,500m.

activities.name: Explore Da Lat Town
activities.description: Stroll around Xuan Huong Lake, the Crazy House, and French colonial villas. Cool, misty, romantic.

days.neighborhoods: Da Lat · Waterfalls · Coffee Farms

activities.name: Datanla Waterfall & Canyoning
activities.description: Alpine coaster to Datanla Falls. Canyoning: rappel waterfalls, cliff jump, natural slides.

activities.name: Coffee Farm Tour
activities.description: Da Lat's best arabica. Learn about weasel coffee, taste single-origin brews, buy beans.

days.neighborhoods: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City · District 1

activities.name: Fly Da Lat → Ho Chi Minh City
activities.description: Short flight to Tan Son Nhat. Welcome to Saigon — Vietnam's electric southern capital.

activities.name: District 1 Walking Tour
activities.description: Notre-Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Reunification Palace, and War Remnants Museum.

days.neighborhoods: HCMC · Cu Chi Tunnels · Chinatown

activities.name: Cu Chi Tunnels
activities.description: Explore the incredible tunnel network. Crawl through tunnels, see booby traps, optional AK-47 range.

activities.name: Cholon (Chinatown)
activities.description: Chinese temples, traditional medicine shops, and the massive Binh Tay Market.

days.neighborhoods: HCMC · Saigon Culture · Coffee Scene

activities.name: Ben Thanh Market
activities.description: Saigon's most famous market — haggle for lacquerware, ao dai fabric, coffee, souvenirs.

activities.name: Jade Emperor Pagoda & Apartment Cafes
activities.description: Visit the atmospheric pagoda, then explore Saigon's hidden apartment building cafes.

activities.name: Rooftop Drinks
activities.description: Saigon Saigon, Chill Skybar, or Air 360 for panoramic city lights.

days.neighborhoods: Mekong Delta · My Tho · Ben Tre

activities.name: Drive to the Mekong Delta
activities.description: Depart HCMC (2 hrs). Board a boat into the maze of palm-fringed canals.

activities.name: Ben Tre: Coconut Kingdom
activities.description: Sampan to Ben Tre island. Coconut candy workshops, beekeeping, tropical orchards.

days.neighborhoods: Mekong Delta · Cai Rang Floating Market · Can Tho

activities.name: Cai Rang Floating Market
activities.description: Wake at 5AM for hundreds of boats selling fruits, vegetables, and phở from the water.

activities.name: Explore Can Tho
activities.description: Binh Thuy Ancient House, Ong Pagoda, riverside promenade. Vietnam at its most laid-back.

activities.name: Return to HCMC
activities.description: Drive back (3.5 hrs). Final night in Saigon.

days.neighborhoods: HCMC · Departure Day

activities.name: Last Morning in Saigon
activities.description: Final Vietnamese coffee, last souvenirs. Visit Tao Dan Park for birdcage enthusiasts.

activities.name: Departure
activities.description: Transfer to Tan Son Nhat Airport. Hẹn gặp lại, Vietnam — until next time. 🇻🇳
